summary: The simulation effectively models mask-wearing behavior influenced by social networks but needs improvements in timing accuracy and data visualization. Recent changes have maintained functionality but lack enhancements in key areas such as time-to-peak accuracy and visualization.

critical_issues.impact: The simulation overestimates the time it takes for the population to reach peak mask adoption, affecting the accuracy of temporal predictions.
critical_issues.solution: Calibrate influence dynamics, perhaps by increasing the influence factor or adjusting intervention timing, to better match real-world data.

critical_issues.impact: Without comprehensive visualizations, it is difficult to assess and communicate the dynamics of mask adoption over time.
critical_issues.solution: Enhance visualization methods to include time series plots and detailed adoption rate displays per demographic group.

model_improvements.current_approach: Influence and government intervention affect risk perception uniformly.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Introduce variability in influence effects and stagger intervention impacts to better capture rapid changes.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Improved alignment with real-world response times, leading to better time-to-peak accuracy.

model_improvements.current_approach: A fixed influence factor is applied uniformly across all connections.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Incorporate variable influence factors based on connection type, frequency of interactions, and prior adoption behavior.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More realistic simulation of social dynamics and behavior adoption patterns.

code_improvements.modification: Adjust influence dynamics and intervention application to better calibrate time-to-peak.
code_improvements.reason: To address the overestimation of time-to-peak behavior change.

code_improvements.modification: Implement additional visualization functions to represent demographic-specific adoption trends.
code_improvements.reason: To provide deeper insights into simulation results and improve assessment of temporal trends.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: The simulation predicts a slower response to interventions than observed in real data.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Refine influence propagation and intervention timing to better capture rapid behavior changes.
